intent: Write the test for ValidationService (context telemetry-ingestion-processing) at the test file path; the unit under test lives at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/validation/application/ValidationService.java. Assert only against the tabled surface. Telemetry Validation rule owner. Every sample is validated against Sensor Metric Boundaries from TelemetryProperties before downstream propagation: heart_rate within [heartRateMin,heartRateMax], power within [powerMin,powerMax], cadence within [cadenceMin,cadenceMax] (inclusive), swim_pace strictly greater than swimPaceMinExclusive; ground_contact_time, respiration, swim_stroke and unknown metrics are unbounded and VALID. Returns the sample with status VALID or VALIDATION_FAILED; the payload is never dropped or altered otherwise. Counter telemetry.validation.samples with tag status=valid or status=failed per sample. observability.step_logs: validation.sample.validated (valid sample, via the StepLog instance method emit) ; observability.step_logs: validation.sample.failed (invalid sample, via the StepLog instance method emit). Both resolved through the sample's correlationId. observability.step_logs = ["validation.sample.validated", "validation.sample.failed"] TEST DUTIES: Cover inclusive boundary values, just-out-of-range values, swim pace equal to the lower bound (failed), unbounded metrics, payload preserved on failure, counters per status, and the StepLog instance method emit step names.

methods.signature: ValidationService(TelemetryProperties properties, StepLog stepLog, MeterRegistry meterRegistry)

methods.semantics: out of range: status VALIDATION_FAILED, counted in telemetry.validation.samples{status=failed}
